boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-admission outings around Daytona Beach, from photography and public art to gardens, waterfront walks, historic landmarks, and live music.

cards.title: Browse Photography Exhibitions
cards.subtitle: A free gallery hang on the Daytona State College campus
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition and closure notices, then meet inside the Hosseini Center for an unhurried gallery walk.
cards.short_summary: Explore changing and permanent photography displays together without buying museum tickets.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that entry is free to all visitors and that most programs and events are also free and public.
cards.source_title: Museum FAQs — Southeast Museum of Photography
cards.access_notes: Free to all visitors; verify the museum's current opening hours and installation closures before leaving.

cards.title: Walk Among Gardens and Mill Ruins
cards.subtitle: Botanical paths, historic machinery, and vintage dinosaur statues
cards.notes: Follow the marked paths through the plants, pause at the sugar-mill remains, and look for butterflies and old park statues.
cards.short_summary: Share a garden walk combining local history, tropical plants, and wonderfully unexpected dinosaurs.
cards.evidence_claim: Volusia County lists admission as free and describes trails, sugar-mill remains, dinosaur statues, butterflies, and native flora.
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; donations are optional. Open daily 8 a.m.–5 p.m., except Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

cards.title: Take a Wild-Beach Walk
cards.subtitle: Two miles of undeveloped Atlantic shoreline north of campus
cards.notes: Bring water and walk the sandy shoreline as a group, keeping clear of marked dunes and any protected wildlife areas.
cards.short_summary: Trade city scenery for a long, no-ticket walk beside dunes, surf, and coastal habitat.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Daytona Beach tourism page says this recreation area is open daily with free admission and offers more than two miles of beach.
cards.source_title: 15 Fun, Free Things to Do in Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Open daily with free admission. Follow posted state-recreation-area and wildlife-protection rules.

cards.title: Bird-Watch Across the Preserve
cards.subtitle: A free coastal-to-river nature outing in Ponce Inlet
cards.notes: Walk quietly with binoculars or a camera, then compare sightings near the dunes, maritime hammock, and river wetlands.
cards.short_summary: Make a low-key group challenge of spotting birds across several distinct coastal habitats.
cards.evidence_claim: The official tourism bureau includes Ponce Preserve among its free activities and describes it as a 41-acre bird-watching site spanning ocean to river.
cards.source_title: 15 Fun, Free Things to Do in Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: No admission or purchase is required for the preserve outing; observe posted park and habitat rules.

cards.title: Stage a Mural Photo Walk
cards.subtitle: A self-guided public-art circuit around the Daytona Beach area
cards.notes: Choose several mural stops before setting out, then trade camera duty so everyone leaves with art-focused portraits.
cards.short_summary: Turn Daytona's outdoor artworks into a collaborative photo prompt requiring no gallery ticket.
cards.evidence_claim: The official tourism bureau lists the Daytona Beach Mural Trail as a free activity for locating murals and public artwork around the area.
cards.source_title: 15 Fun, Free Things to Do in Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Viewing the outdoor artwork is free; remain in public areas and do not enter private property.

cards.title: Follow the Racing Plaques
cards.subtitle: A free self-guided motorsports-history walk by the ocean
cards.notes: Start near the oceanfront and read the commemorative plaques together; skip the paid rides and arcade attractions nearby.
cards.short_summary: Pair sea air with a self-guided look at the boardwalk's automobile and motorcycle racing markers.
cards.evidence_claim: The official tourism bureau says visitors can take a free self-guided tour of the Boardwalk's automobile- and motorcycle-racing plaques.
cards.source_title: 15 Fun, Free Things to Do in Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Walking and viewing the plaques require no purchase; arcade games, rides, food, and some parking options cost extra.

cards.title: Walk the Halifax Riverfront
cards.subtitle: A mile-long running trail with gardens, swings, and river views
cards.notes: Meet near Beach Street, follow the waterfront trail, and claim a bench or swing for a conversation beside the Halifax River.
cards.short_summary: Use the landscaped river edge for a relaxed social loop with plenty of places to pause.
cards.evidence_claim: The official tourism bureau includes Riverfront Esplanade among Daytona's free activities and identifies its mile-long waterfront trail, benches, and swings.
cards.source_title: 15 Fun, Free Things to Do in Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Public trail use requires no admission or purchase; use posted operating information for individual amenities.

cards.entity_name: Volusia County Charters of Freedom Monument
cards.title: Read the Charters of Freedom
cards.subtitle: An outdoor civics stop beside the Riverfront Esplanade
cards.notes: Read one installed document apiece, then regroup to compare details from the Constitution, amendments, and Declaration.
cards.short_summary: Add a focused history-and-civics stop to a free downtown riverfront walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The official tourism bureau lists the monument among its free activities and says founding and civil-rights documents are permanently installed there.
cards.source_title: 15 Fun, Free Things to Do in Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: The outdoor monument can be viewed without admission or a purchase; combine it with the adjacent public esplanade.

cards.title: Picnic by the Birthplace of Speed
cards.subtitle: An oceanfront park commemorating the beach's 1903 automobile race
cards.notes: Pack your own snack, inspect the racing memorial, and use the dune walkover for a group photo without disturbing vegetation.
cards.short_summary: Combine an ocean view, early racing history, and a bring-your-own picnic at one compact park.
cards.evidence_claim: The official tourism bureau includes Birthplace of Speed Park among its free activities and identifies picnic facilities, restrooms, and a dune walkover.
cards.source_title: 15 Fun, Free Things to Do in Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Park access requires no admission or purchase; bringing food is optional, and no on-site purchase is necessary.

cards.title: Catch a Friday Bandshell Concert
cards.subtitle: Free general-admission music at the oceanfront amphitheater
cards.notes: Bring a chair, arrive before the 7:15 p.m. start, and settle into the general-admission area for a free summer show.
cards.short_summary: Gather for live tribute music in a landmark coquina amphitheater without purchasing a ticket.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026 Sounds of Summer page says Friday concerts run June 12–August 28 at 7:15 p.m. and general admission is free.
cards.source_title: Daytona Beach Sounds of Summer Concert Series
cards.access_notes: General admission is free for the published 2026 Friday concerts; optional VIP seating and parking may cost extra.
